phase3_findings.description: scripts/context_eval_shared.py's _iter_session_files drops a non-.jsonl file with no tally and no breadcrumb, contradicting its own docstring claim that both walk-level drops are tallied; the cloud tier falls through it silently.
The added sentence 'Its transcript-directory operand is what separates it from the fixture reproduction above' is false against HEAD: both invocations take one transcript-directory positional.
The Corpus root cell records a glob while the adjacent instruction says to substitute it into the <transcript-dir> operand, which os.path.isdir requires to be a directory.
'Cloud-tier runs are not measurable by this tool today' is stronger than the suffix mechanism it cites, and the private page records a 5-run cloud corpus measured with the same instrument.
